system.description:
Also, at 6th Level, you learn a new molding technique called Tectonic Mantle that you can use by spending 2 Focus.

All allied creatures within 20 feet of a Geo-Ether gain resistance to the next instance of damage they take before the start of your next turn.

All hostile creatures that fail this jutsu’s saving throw has their speed reduced to 0 until the beginning of your next turn and suffer disadvantage on the next Dexterity saving throw they make before the beginning of your next turn. Additionally, if an affected creature is a Demon, Monstrosity or Undead, they instead suffer disadvantage on any saving throws before the beginning of your next turn.
